name: Less Than 5Gr of Saffron
summary:
🏆 Winner of the Special Jury Prize at Venice Immersive 2025, step into an intimate VR story about memory, exile, and the invisible aftermath of survival.

Less Than 5gr of Saffron follows Golnaz, a young Iranian woman rebuilding her life in Germany after a traumatic migration journey. One evening, exhausted and hungry, she comes across saffron in a supermarket — a rare and precious spice that immediately brings back memories of home.
